sources.title: Qwen 3.8 27B is excellent, but it defaults to wildly overthinking things
sources.snippet: Qwen's self-reported benchmarks for this model are eye-opening. They show a boost from both Qwen 3.6 27B and the closed-weight Qwen 3.7-Plus, which was one of Qwen's strongest models of any size as recently as May this year. It will be interesting to hear what independent benchmarks have to say about the model.
